arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Roberts stated the barge lacked Coast Guard inspection.
Mr. Roberts noted the Coast Guard has few safety rules for this barge.
Mr. Veters asserted the Coast Guard has absolute authority over uninspected vessels.
Mr. Veters claimed no difference exists between inspected and uninspected vessels.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case involves a fatal explosion on a Louisiana drilling barge. The barge lacked Coast Guard inspection. The parties disagree on which agency sets safety rules.
